Project Management

This section contains the main project management documents used during the development of the TER Robotique project.

These documents describe the project organization, planning, specifications, and development process followed throughout the project.

Available documents

The following resources are available:

  • Cahier des charges

  • Plan de développement

  • Diagramme de Gantt

Document descriptions

Cahier des charges

This document defines the project objectives, constraints, requirements, and expected functionalities of the robotic system.

Plan de développement

This document explains the development strategy, technical organization, and implementation process of the project.

Diagramme de Gantt

This planning document presents the project schedule, milestones, task distribution, and development timeline.

Project organization

The project is organized into several phases:

  1. Requirement analysis

  2. Hardware and software design

  3. Development and integration

  4. Testing and validation

  5. Final documentation and presentation
